title: Captain Jack's Stormy Rescue
moral: Being brave and helping others is important.

scenes.summary: Captain Jack sets out to help a ship in trouble.

story: Captain Jack, a brave pirate, sailed with his crew to rescue a ship in trouble. A big storm began with strong winds and waves, making the journey dangerous. Captain Jack held the wheel and encouraged his crew to work together as they sailed through the storm. Captain Jack and his crew helped the people onto their ship, saving them from danger. The storm ended, and Captain Jack and his crew returned safely, proud of their bravery and kindness.
